text: Brought this to book club last month and it sparked one of our best discussions. Half the group thought the supernatural elements were real, half thought Renata was having a breakdown, and nobody could prove the other side wrong. That's a sign of a story doing something right. The way measurement keeps failing -- the Protimeter, the photographs, the tape reading numbers out of order -- really got under my skin. When your tools stop working, what do you have left? Also the debt ledger hit hard. Those names and their impossible debts, the way a fourteen-year-old inherits his brother's debt. The house remembers what the official records erased.
